note: Shoshone NF campground on Louis Lake, 7.5 miles up Forest Road 300 from WY-28 just before South Pass City (about 35 miles south of Lander). Sites around the south shore and the Louis Creek outlet; bear boxes, food storage required. Louis Lake Lodge nearby rents boats and horses. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated 2026-09-23) read: 9 sites, 24-ft max spur, vault toilets, no water, $15 ($20 when water is on), cash/check, 16-day limit, FCFS (no rec.gov listing); now 'Closed for the season' (no dates given). Lakefront kept after a hard imagery check, with the caveat that sites are unnumbered. Phone empty -> (307) 332-5460 (Washakie RD).
flags: WATERFRONT (checked hard): lakefront kept. No site map or site numbers are published and there is no rec.gov catalog, so the sites can only be located on imagery: lakeside pads on the loop's spurs (~42.5933,-108.8445) are ~15-25 m from the water through a thin line of pines, and open sandy pull-offs east of the loop (~42.5945,-108.8423, ~42.5944,-108.8417) run to the waterline across open ground ~10-25 m. Whether those east pull-offs are among the nine designated sites cannot be confirmed from the FS page ('nine campsites around Louis Lake and the outlet of Louis Creek'). If they are not, the call rests on the loop spurs behind a tree line, which would be lakeview. All sites first-come, nightly.

SAND (criteria, report): the lakeside pull-offs are bare sandy ground - packed sand on a maintained road, not open beach as far as imagery shows, but worth AWH's eye given the no-open-beach-sand rule.

PHONE: empty -> (307) 332-5460, Washakie Ranger District (Lander), per the Shoshone offices page. The campground page's contact block names 'Clarks Fork Ranger District, 307-527-6921' - apparently copied from the Cody-area pages; Louis Lake is south of Lander. Website FS r02 page live.

PIN: stored 42.59217,-108.84362 is on FR-300 at the loop's south entrance, ~50 m S of the FS point (42.5926,-108.84371) and ~130 m from the lakeside pads - under 250 m, no move; a better centre would be ~42.5930,-108.8440.
SEASON: page says 'Closed for the season' with no dates; nothing written.
